releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.18 — the app can now talk to a real backend. Open Settings ▸ Server and paste the address of a running NChat server (or build the APK with NCHAT_API_BASE) and sign in, chat, create groups, follow statuses and see your call history straight from it — with live updates over one socket, optimistic sends and read receipts. Leave the field empty and everything keeps working on the built-in demo data, exactly as before.
